certificates.title: Nyochaa asambodo
certificates.text: Dobe asambodo e chekwara site na Gbasara azịza a, ihe akaebe ya, ma ọ bụ ha abụọ, ya na faịlụ ọ bụla ọ kpọrọ aha. Ma ọ bụ dobe foto, vidiyo ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ iji gụọ otu e si mee ya. Ọ dịghị ihe ị nyere na-apụ na peeji a.
certificates.unreadable: Nke a abụghị asambodo nke azịza, ihe akaebe ya, ma ọ bụ faịlụ na-akọ otu e si mee ya.
certificates.intact: Akara ya, ọ gbanwebeghị kemgbe ahụ
certificates.broken: Agbanweela ya, ma ọ bụ igodo ọ kpọrọ aha akaraghị ya
certificates.where.device: E mere ya na ngwaọrụ ahụ kara ya akara
certificates.where.outside: E zigara ya na mpụga ngwaọrụ ahụ kara ya akara
certificates.where.unknown: Enweghị asambodo maka ebe e mere ya
certificates.proven: Ihe akaebe ya na-egosi okwu ndị ahụ
certificates.unproven: Ihe akaebe a abụghị nke asambodo a
certificates.logged: Ọ dị na ndekọ ọha, ntinye {index}
certificates.notLogged: Ọ dịghị na ndekọ ọha ọ kpọrọ aha
certificates.logSays: Ọ na-ekwu na ọ dị na ndekọ ọha, ntinye {index}
certificates.credentials: {name} nwere ndekọ e binyere aka nke otu e si mee ya, ọ gbanwebeghị kemgbe ahụ
certificates.credentialsBroken: {name} nwere ndekọ nke otu e si mee ya nke na-adabaghị: agbanweela ya, ma ọ bụ igodo ọ kpọrọ aha abinyeghị ya aka
certificates.ai: Ọ na-ekwu na AI mere ya
certificates.notAi: Ọ naghị ekwu na AI mere ya
certificates.unbound: A naghị enyocha ebe a ma faịlụ ahụ ọ gbanwela kemgbe ahụ
certificates.noRecord: {name} enweghị ndekọ ọ bụla nke otu e si mee ya
certificates.marks: {name} na-akọ otu e si mee ya, n’ebinyeghị aka: onye ọ bụla nwere ike ide ya
certificates.watermark.match: Akara mmiri ya a na-adịghị ahụ anya bụ nke ndekọ a kpọrọ aha
certificates.watermark.other: Akara mmiri ya a na-adịghị ahụ anya abụghị nke ndekọ a kpọrọ aha
certificates.watermark.found: O nwere akara mmiri a na-adịghị ahụ anya
certificates.watermark.none: Ahụghị akara mmiri a na-adịghị ahụ anya
certificates.watermark.fetch: Iji chọọ akara mmiri a na-adịghị ahụ anya, peeji a ga-ebu ụzọ budata ihe ọgụgụ ya site na {host}, wee debe ya n’ihe nchọgharị a
certificates.words: Ma ọ bụ mado okwu iji chọọ akara mmiri nke ụbụrụ dị na ngwaọrụ
certificates.words.marked: Okwu ndị a nwere akara mmiri nke ụbụrụ dị na ngwaọrụ: ọ dere ha, ma ọ bụ mmadụ mere ka ha dị otu ahụ
certificates.words.none: Ahụghị akara mmiri nke ụbụrụ dị na ngwaọrụ n’okwu ndị a, nke a egosighị na ọ bụghị ya dere ha
certificates.words.short: Okwu adịghị ezu iji mara: mado ihe dị ka otu peeji
certificates.words.fetch: Iji chọọ akara mmiri n’okwu, peeji a ga-ebu ụzọ budata ihe ọgụgụ ya site na {host}, wee debe ya n’ihe nchọgharị a
certificates.log.fetch: Iji nyochaa na ndekọ ọha na-akwado ya, peeji a ga-ebu ụzọ budata igodo ndekọ ahụ site na {host}
certificates.failed: Enweghị ike ibudata ihe ọ bụla site na {host}. Nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa.
certificates.trust.trusted: Ọ nwere asambodo sitere n’aka ụlọ ọrụ nzukọ gị tụkwasịrị obi
certificates.trust.unchecked: Ọ nwere asambodo sitere n’aka ụlọ ọrụ nzukọ gị tụkwasịrị obi, na-enweghị ihe akaebe na a kagbughị ya
certificates.trust.untrusted: Ọ nweghị asambodo sitere n’aka ụlọ ọrụ nzukọ gị tụkwasịrị obi
certificates.trust.revoked: A kagburu asambodo ya tupu e kaa nke a akara
certificates.qualified: Akara ruru eru n’okpuru iwu EU
